authority.presentation: Unreal overmap actors/materials only; presentation does not invent campaign outcomes

requirements: settlement silhouette readable at regional zoom

terrain.rule: purpose-built continuous terrain; donor landscapes are source vocabulary, not stitched levels
terrain.scale: compressed strategic geography; absolute kilometres deferred

roads.presentation: terrain-following roads/trails with destination highlight only when selected
roads.canonical_semantics: one adjacent-region action in founder slice; independent logistics movement cost
roads.selected_route_overlay: temporary readable highlight, never permanent board lines

settlements.rule: overmap landmark proxy must resemble the actual visitable settlement donor
settlements.interaction: select for details; enter/visit transitions to the physical town presentation

heroes_and_armies.presentation: world party actor with readable hero/banner identity; modest scale exaggeration allowed
heroes_and_armies.movement: animate along validated route after canonical move succeeds
heroes_and_armies.regiment_detail: do not render every soldier on the campaign map

fog.explored_not_visible: terrain memory remains; current armies/changes are hidden
fog.visible: show current armies, settlement condition and relevant interactables

territory.default: terrain and faction occupation communicate ownership without permanent hard province borders
territory.selection: subtle temporary ownership wash/outline is allowed on demand

battle_handshake.promise: campaign geography visible to the player must be honored by tactical battlefield selection

performance.settlements: use simplified overmap proxies; load full visitable town only when entering it
performance.micro_props: do not carry town-showcase clutter onto the overmap

founder_slice_gate: nine founder regions use current exact IDs and UE blockout positions
three distinct short approaches to Orc Stronghold remain legible
Old Quarry and Forest Edge read as resource opportunities
River Ford and North Pass visibly read as crossing/chokepoint geography
Human Capital and Orc Stronghold are recognizable from their visitable-city silhouettes
fog, AP spending, region selection and AI movement remain driven by existing canonical state
